The couple shared the news in a gender reveal video posted on their Instagram page, showing the moment they discovered the sex of their unborn child. The announcement attracted congratulatory messages from fans and followers, many of whom celebrated the couple as they prepare to welcome their first child. The pregnancy announcement comes amid public interest in the relationship between the two social media personalities, who have frequently shared personal moments with their online audience. Peller and Jarvis are known for their livestreams and comedy content, which have earned them substantial followings across social media platforms.
